Management Accountant
Reporting to the Financial Controller, you will own the month-end close.
Responsibilities
- Prepare monthly management accounts and variance analysis for the board.
- Own bank reconciliation and balance sheet reconciliation across three entities.
- Support the annual audit and liaise with external auditors.
- Maintain fixed asset registers and depreciation schedules.
- Drive process improvement across the purchase ledger.
Requirements
- ACA, ACCA or CIMA qualified.
- Advanced Excel including pivot tables and VLOOKUP.
- Experience with SAP and NetSuite.
- Knowledge of IFRS 16 and UK GAAP.
- Exposure to cash flow forecasting and budgeting.
- Excellent attention to detail and strong communication skills.
